notes: Operating case temperature also offered as Extended (-20 to +80°C) and Industrial (-40 to +85°C); DO-BL5324-20DI ordering is -40°C~+85°C. temp_min_c/temp_max_c reflect Standard grade (0 to +70°C). Transmitter centre wavelength λc 1530–1570 nm (typ 1550 nm); receiver centre wavelength λc 1260–1360 nm (typ 1310 nm). Spectral width (-20 dB) Δλ max 1 nm. Supply +3.3 V; Icc max 300 mA (no power in W stated). Rx sensitivity and overload measured PRBS 2^7-1 @ 1250 Mbps, BER ≤ 1×10^-12. Optical power launched into SMF.
